uncited: It builds on [3D Covariance Computation](2231-3d-covariance-computation.md) and differs from [Pre-computed Covariance and Color Buffer Generation](2817-pre-computed-covariance-and-color-buffer-generation.md) by keeping the covariance parameters differentiable and optimized end-to-end rather than precomputed.
**Parameterize Scale:** The scale parameters are optimized directly.
*   **Precision:** The reconstruction $R \cdot \text{diag}(s)^2 \cdot R^T$ must be computed with sufficient precision to maintain symmetry.
*   **When not to use:** Not given in the sources.
